task: HoH-QAs short-answer retrieval over 111971 paired revisions, development seed fixed by selection.json. All methods answer the identical 32 page-disjoint queries. No gold or source IDs used by serving.
primary: Normalized exact match, then bag-of-token F1. Lowercase Unicode word sequences, ignore a/an/the. Single official latest reference. Adaptation of the task, not the authors' LLM judge.
hypothesis: Transferring uncertain extractive answer boundaries from the earlier edition, or contrasting version-specific attention at decoding, improves current-answer selection when current-only reading fails.
generative: Qwen3.5-4B BF16 greedy up to 32 tokens. Direct 1/4, expanded 4 and explicit historical+current text. Compare current against whole old, earlier attention KV with current conv/matrix, and earlier recurrent matrix with current attention/conv. 2*positive-negative within x0.1 relative probability of best positive for first 6 steps.
extractive: Pinned RoBERTa-SQuAD2. Max span 24 subtokens; old top 64 spans, align old/new subtoken strings with SequenceMatcher. Enumerate all current spans; transfer mass of top 64 old spans to current boundaries; score current logits plus log(0.10+normalized pushed mass). Passage ranking by span-vs-null margin minus log(1+rank). Compare BM25 top1, direct top4, expanded top4, pure best old projection, first textual change, direct copy, and use of current-only reader. Bound score to top4 for all expanded readers.
gate: A candidate advances to 96 sealed pages at 9B if it beats every practical non-candidate (including strongest extractive and generative baseline) by at least 3/32 exact answers and is at least tied in token F1. Attention must also beat whole-history contrast; soft span projection must also beat hard projection. Candidate comparison exploratory on dev. Efficiency claims require separate matched end-to-end execution and >=20% improvement without loss. No timing claim from shared decode.
budgets: One 30-minute limit per generator and reader process, one implementation repair, local MLX/CPU, zero paid credits. No tuning on reserved pages.
